statement: The author-corrected Suzuki S_t is unconditionally in L². Real-axis cancellation gives a uniform bounded-time pointwise envelope of order log(2+|x|)/(1+|x|), finite norm enclosures and a local time modulus, whereas the model-space Parseval identity still requires its arithmetic positivity premise.

For ω ≥ 0, eventual Ψ(t) ≥ −C exp(ωt) is equivalent to the zero-free half-plane Re s > 1/2+ω. The same eventual upper bound on norm defect ||S_t||²/(2π)−Ψ(t) suffices. This is a global tail condition.

In a symmetric entire-function model, a unit off-axis quartet at large height can change both norm and kernel data by arbitrarily little on a prior bounded time interval. This does not rule out certificates using additional arithmetic structure and is not a model of actual zeta zeros.
